items.title: Elon Musk's millions fail to deliver Texas for the Republicans in fierce midterms

items.lede: Elon Musk almost single-handedly funded the Republican midterms push. But of every traceable dollar Musk put into races that have been decided, more than 99 cents went to a race he lost.
